information: ***Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.*** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. ***This competition will recognize the highest-ranked competitor that resides in the state of Oklahoma as the Oklahoma Champion 2024 in each event being held.*** Only a resident of Oklahoma is eligible to win the title of Oklahoma Champ. However, all Cubers are welcome, and encouraged to compete!!
